plan.summary: BRO-5549 follow-up: five printed source lines quoted a title inside a quote with double marks, so the show card read ""The Band’s Visit" has recouped". The Band’s Visit and The Play That Goes Wrong (both added by bro-5549) and The Anarchist (older) now use single marks inside the quote. commercial-record-checks.js warns on doubled quotation marks from now on, which the approved-fix runner refuses on touched records.
steps: Each edit replaces one exact substring of the live value.
